notes.title: Big News: We’ve Partnered with Games Operators!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey Survivors,[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve got something very exciting to share today something that brings us one step closer to getting ANGST into your hands.[/p][p]We’re proud to announce that we’ve officially partnered with Games Operators, the team behind standout titles like Infection Free Zone, 911 Operator,Rustler and many more.[/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/gameops"]https://store.steampowered.com/developer/gameops[/url][/p][p][/p][p]These folks know how to bring unique, genre-defining games to life, and now they’re helping us do the same with ANGST.[/p][p][/p][p]So, what does this mean?
It means more visibility, more reach, and more support everything we need to take Angst from a cold, harsh idea to a full-on, playable survival experience. We’re now better equipped to bring this game to life and, most importantly, to your computers.[/p][p]This is a big step forward, and we’re incredibly excited about what’s coming next. New updates and more ways for you to survive the frozen dark are on the way.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for sticking with us and welcome to the next phase of the journey.[/p][p][/p][p]Stay alive out there,
– The Cherrypick Games Team[/p]

notes.title: Demo is coming soon
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]It’s been a while since the last update, but we’ve got some good news to share. Work on ANGST has been moving forward, and we’re now getting closer to the point where we can finally put the game in your hands.The first step? A demo is coming soon.We’re polishing up the core experience so you’ll be able to get an early taste of the story, the survival elements, and the atmosphere that makes ANGST what it is. This demo will also help us gather feedback and make sure we’re hitting the right notes before launch.[/p][p]We don’t want to spoil too much just yet, but here’s the important part: things are moving, the finish line is in sight, and you’ll be able to play ANGST sooner than you think.Stay tuned more details (and the demo itself) are right around the corner.[/p][p]Thanks for being with us on this journey.[/p][p]The ANGST Team[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: ANGST Dev Update
notes.notes:
Hey Survivors,

First off, sorry for the radio silence, we’ve been deep in the frost, quietly working away on Angst, and we’re finally coming up for air.

[b]The good news? [/b]
Development is very much alive, and we’re pushing hard to make this the best version of Angst yet.

We also have a little spoiler to drop:
[b]Base building is coming.[/b]
Yep, we’ve decided to bring this feature into the game. It’s still early, but we’re building out systems that will let you carve out a bit of safety in the cold, hostile world - and defend it.

Alongside that, we’re adding other cool features, which we’ll be sharing more about soon. Expect updates with more detail and some fresh visuals in the near future.

Thanks for sticking with us. We’re still here, still building, and still committed to delivering something special.


Stay warm, stay sharp - survival is still not guaranteed.

[i]- The Cherrypick Games Team[/i]

notes.title: ANGST Dev Update
notes.notes:
Hey Survivors!

We’ve been in development, making tweaks and improvements to Angst, and we wanted to share a quick update. Thanks to all of you who participated in our playtests and community discussions—your feedback has been invaluable! We’ve been listening carefully and are working hard to refine the game based on your insights.

:fire: What’s On?

Survival Mechanics Overhaul – We’re doubling down on deepening survival elements while keeping them accessible and engaging. Every decision will matter.

Combat Adjustments – Encounters are being fine-tuned to feel more intense and rewarding. Every fight should be a battle for survival, not just a formality... also, new enemy types are now lurking in the frozen dark!

Base Building? Maybe! – Many of you have asked about this, and we’re exploring ways to implement a meaningful, strategic base-building element.

A Bit Revised Art Direction – We’re experimenting with some tweaks to the visual style to enhance the overall atmosphere and make Angst even more immersive.

Story – Peeling Back the Layers

While ANGST is, at its core, a survival experience, we always envisioned it as something more—a story that unfolds as you endure. With that in mind, we’ve been layering in new narrative elements to heighten immersion and mystery.

Your feedback has played a huge role in shaping these changes, and we’re committed to making Angst the best experience possible.

Stay safe out there—survival is never guaranteed...

— The Cherrypick Games Team

notes.title: ANGST Devlog: Playtest Closed – Thank You!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

The ANGST open playtest has officially come to a close, and we can’t thank you enough for joining us over the past months. Your dedication, passion, and insightful feedback have been nothing short of incredible. Watching you explore the depths of ANGST and share your thoughts has been an unforgettable experience for our team.

What’s Next?
With the playtest behind us, we’re now focusing on analyzing all the valuable feedback you’ve provided. Every comment, suggestion, and bug report will guide us in refining and perfecting the game as we move closer to launch.

📬 Didn’t Get a Chance to Join?
Don’t worry—this is just one chapter in the ANGST journey. There’s plenty more to come, including future playtests, sneak peeks, and exciting announcements. Be sure to follow our Steam page so you don’t miss a thing.

💬 Stay Engaged
The ANGST community is growing stronger every day, and we’d love for you to remain a part of it. Share your playtest experiences, connect with fellow players, and let us know what you’re most excited about as we move forward.

Thank you for helping shape ANGST into something truly special. Your support means the world to us, and we can’t wait to share what’s next.

This is just the beginning, and we promise the best is yet to come. 👁️

Hey everyone!

We’re blown away by the incredible response to the ANGST playtest. Your feedback, support, and enthusiasm have been nothing short of inspiring. It’s amazing to see our community growing and your input shaping the game into something truly special.

But time is running out! The ANGST open playtest closes in just 24 hours, and we don’t want you to miss this final chance to dive in, explore the game, and help shape its future.

notes.title: Developer's Update: ANGST – Open Single Player Playtest
notes.notes:
Hey survivors,
Angst is now available for open playtest of the single player mode! We also invite everyone to sign up for our Discord and tell us what you think. We want to gather as much feedback to make the best game possible.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wl3JsRNdOx0

[h3]Key Inspirations and Features of the full game:[/h3]

When we started developing ANGST, our goal was to go beyond traditional survival mechanics. Here’s what we focused on: [list]
[*][b]Survival with dynamic challenges:[/b] Each narrative plot introduces new quests and challenges. Learn, adapt, and venture deeper into the wild to uncover the mystery behind the Angst.

[*][b]Dynamic multiplayer environments:[/b] Procedurally generated worlds with harsh biomes that shift and evolve as you play, making every co-op mission unique.
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Death as part of progress:[/b] Each death reveals more about the world’s rules and brings you closer to understanding the Angst and the story behind it.
[/list] 
[list]
[*][b]Emotional depth:[/b] More than just survival—experience the psychological struggles of isolation, fear, and uncertainty. Redemption awaits as guilt, sorrow, and helplessness pull you deeper into limbo.
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Mysterious entities:[/b] Encounter strange beings—some will help, others will hinder—adding layers of tension and mystery to your journey.
[/list]
[h3]What’s Next:[/h3]
As we approach the next stage of development, we’re hard at work refining the core systems and mechanics that make ANGST so compelling. [b]And now, we’re inviting YOU to join the open Single Player Playtest starting October 14th on Steam![/b]

Here’s how you can be part of the journey:
[list]
[*][b]Single Player Playtest the game starting October 14th:[/b] Get early access to explore ANGST and provide valuable feedback on the game’s mechanics and overall experience.
[/list]
[list]
[*][b]Wishlist on Steam and join our Discord:[/b] Stay up to date on news and updates as we approach the full launch.
[/list]

Thanks again for joining us on this journey!
The Cherrypick Games Team

notes.title: Dev Log #1 - Welcome to ANGST: A TALE OF SURVIVAL!
notes.notes:
We are Cherrypick Games, an indie studio from Warsaw, Poland, made up of a small, tight-knit 
team of 10 passionate creators. Every one of us is deeply involved in making this game a reality, 
pouring our hearts into it - and we’re beyond excited to finally start sharing it with you!

[h1]Introducing our passion project - ANGST: A TALE OF SURVIVAL[/h1]

This isn’t just another game for us. It’s the culmination of everything we love about storytelling, immersive worlds, and gameplay that challenges players to think on their feet. We’re creating something we hope will stand out, something you’ll want to dive into again and again.

[h2]How It All Began[/h2]

The project started with a simple idea. While brainstorming, we tossed around a ton of concepts, one of which was a game about a character traveling through time. After long discussions and refining, we felt that while it was a cool idea, we wanted something that spoke to players in a deeper way.
That’s when it hit us: [b]What if we mix survival with roguelite mechanics?[/b] We love the survival genre, but we also know how many awesome survival games are out there. We decided to pursue an idea to add something fresh, a mechanic that would tap into the hero progression and enhance this layer of gameplay. We decided to add a roguelite twist. The result? In our game death becomes part of the journey.

[h2]The Title[/h2]

To be honest, we struggled to find a title for our game. We explored several ideas, some quite different from what we ultimately chose. A few examples were: “Remain,” “Somewhere,” “The Nowhere,” “The Cabin,” and “In the Hollow.” Then, “Angst” came up and was added to the whiteboard in our brainstorming room. It clicked immediately!

Angst is a word borrowed from the German language, and according to the Cambridge Dictionary:

[b]angst [/b] noun /æŋst/ - a feeling of great worry about a situation, or about your life.

Perfect!
Interestingly, we often perceive certain words in a way where their pronunciation complements their meaning. For example, the word “long” feels awkward to say briefly; we tend to stretch it out into “loooong.” The same goes for words like “short” and many others. We believe “Angst” is another powerful word that, when thought or spoken aloud, feels as unsettling as its meaning. It evokes the experience of struggling to survive alone in a freezing forest, with mysterious entities lurking in the shadows. Angst turned out to be exactly what we were searching for.

[h2]The Game: ANGST: A TALE OF SURVIVAL[/h2]

ANGST is about more than just surviving — it’s about adapting, learning, and pushing forward in a hostile, ever-changing environment. You’ll face new threats with each run, and even in failure, you’ll gain knowledge and experience that help you in future attempts. The roguelite elements ensure that each time you play, you’re met with new challenges and opportunities, keeping the gameplay fresh and engaging.

The world of ANGST is harsh, but it’s also full of mystery. As you survive longer, you’ll begin to unravel the secrets of the world around you, adding layers of depth to the gameplay and the story.

[h2]Why We Love It[/h2]

We’ve always believed that great games come from passion, and ANGST is a testament to that belief. Every aspect of the game — from its mechanics to its narrative — is being crafted with attention to detail. We want to create something that will not only challenge players but also immerse them in a world they’ll want to explore over and over again.

The first big step toward defining our art style was made when we opted for a low-poly aesthetic.

“That’s a nice hat 😁 ", Mateusz, remarked — and that offhand comment became the spark that ignited our creative direction. With the concept in place, the art team dove into experimenting. After several iterations (and a bit of shader magic), we reached the next stage of development.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/gwBcMyT/Untitled-design-9.jpg[/img]
We all agreed: it looked awesome. Even better, it aligned perfectly with what we had envisioned!

[img]https://i.ibb.co/12t9746/Untitled-design-19.gif[/img]
Next, we turned our focus to how color could shape the game world. Our initial idea was to use cooler tones to represent warmth and safety:

[img]https://i.ibb.co/72jM7MM/Untitled-design-12.jpg[/img]
Nikita began to "bring our dreams to life" by adding a coloring feature to the game. The main idea was that light sources would create an area around them that colors the surrounding objects. And so, the process began. "The floor is lava" 🔥  
Here, you can see how the flames cast light and color onto the surrounding objects.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/QnRPGy9/Untitled-design-10.jpg[/img]
Meanwhile, we were busy experimenting with character "bleeding effects." Our verdict? "Tarantino would be proud!" We also improvised a lot with the tools at our disposal — in our studio, we like to say, "When the world gives you a bench, make a bridge out of it!"

[img]https://i.ibb.co/bBTMrPQ/Untitled-design-21.gif[/img]
We kept tweaking the coloring features for a while, but ultimately decided it wasn't quite hitting the mark. So, we moved on, and our art style continued to evolve from there.

This is where we are today:

[img]https://i.ibb.co/cwtzMnD/Untitled-design-11.jpg[/img]

We’re so excited to share more with you as development progresses. In the coming months, we’ll be offering a behind-the-scenes look at our development process, sharing sneak peeks, and diving deeper into the mechanics that make Angst unique.

Thanks for joining us on this journey.

Stay strong, survivors! 
— The Cherrypick Games Team
